run_navigation_service: run the Pyro4 navigation server that registers the Navigation object on the daemon
go_to_object: navigate the robot to find a specified COCO object category using learned or frontier exploration
go_to_absolute: move the robot to an absolute goal position or goal map with distance and angle thresholds
execute_low_level_command: execute a low-level robot action like forward, left, right, look up, or look down
draw_line: draw a line on a 2D matrix between two points with configurable steps and width
